name: Villanueva de Duero (Spain)
description: White field with a narrow dark blue cross, charged with red houses at the upper hoist and lower fly and green pines at the upper fly and lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de Duero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: houses in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters
pines in the upper fly and lower hoist quarters
